original: You are in a dark misty passage hidden in the mountains.
translation: 你身處山中一條陰暗迷濛的通道。

original: You are in a large dark room.  To the south are three shadowy figures.  You can feel them watching your every move, but can not see their faces.  You feel a creeping chill...
translation: 你身處一間昏暗的大房間。南方有三個陰影般的身形，你能感覺到牠們正注視著你的一舉一動，卻看不清牠們的面容。你感到一股寒意悄悄襲來……

original: A huge shadowy figure and a glint of steel bars your way.  A distant voice whispers, 'We have been watching you....  We have information you want....      Bring us the head of the swamp king and we can talk....'
translation: 一個巨大的陰影身形與一道劍光的閃爍擋住了你的去路。一個遙遠的聲音低語道：「我們一直在看著你……我們有你想要的情報……把沼澤之王的首級帶來，我們就談……」
note: 原文含對齊空白('you want....' 之後有六個空格，疑為刻意停頓效果)；Swamp King 見 107 note。

original: A shadowy figure whispers, 'The first word of the spell to destroy the gate of Ralith is 'DAZA'.
translation: 一個陰影身形低語道：「破解拉利斯(Ralith)之門的咒語，第一個字是『DAZA』。」
note: DAZA 為咒語專用詞，非一般英文單字，依規則保留原文不譯。 專有名詞依 glossary 硬規則 4 保留英文(精訊做法)。

original: A shadowy figure whispers, 'Great wizards know of powerful spells in a mystic language that have been lost in the fabric of time.  The spell guarding the gate to Ralith is one of these.'
translation: 一個陰影身形低語道：「偉大的巫師都知道，有些強大的咒語出自一種神秘語言，早已在時間長河中失傳。守護拉利斯(Ralith)之門的那道咒語，正是其中之一。」
note: 專有名詞依 glossary 硬規則 4 保留英文(精訊做法)。

original: A shadowy figure whispers, 'The only way to get to the island in the lake of fire is to teleport there.  Only the old man in the cave can do this.  He is a friend of the gate keeper.'
translation: 一個陰影身形低語道：「要抵達火湖中的那座島嶼，唯一的辦法就是傳送過去。只有洞穴裡的老者能做到這件事。他是守門者的朋友。」
